fields.title: Backend Developer Intern
fields.description: Join our team to build scalable APIs and microservices for our analytics platform. Work with Python, Django, and PostgreSQL.
fields.requirements: Knowledge of Python and Django. Familiarity with RESTful APIs and relational databases.

fields.title: Frontend Developer Intern
fields.description: Work on modern UI components for our SaaS dashboard using React.js and TypeScript.
fields.requirements: Experience with JavaScript, React.js, and CSS frameworks.

fields.title: Data Science Intern
fields.description: Assist in building machine learning models for predictive analytics. Work closely with our data engineering team.
fields.requirements: Strong foundation in statistics and Python. Experience with pandas and scikit-learn.
